title: The "SCIENTIFIC" Origins of Astrology and Horoscopes
description:
Collab with Abhijit Chanda (Rationable) — [@rationable]
Subscribe to Rationable:https://www.youtube.com/@UCBw4dVlegYC-g5_mnkC780g 

Astrology has a long, fascinating past, but history and evidence tell a different story from the horoscopes. In this episode, we trace the history of astrology from Babylon to today’s birth charts and modern astrology, then show why its claims are too tall. We explain the Barnum effect, confirmation bias, cold reading, and asks difficult questions that astrologers need to answer. If you have ever felt a zodiac sign describe you perfectly, you’ll learn how language and psychology create that “accurate” feeling. Clear, testable explanations. No mysticism. Just the real origins of astrology and why it functions as a modern scam.
